# Backstage Random Quote Plugin

A simple Backstage frontend plugin that displays a random quote in a card.

## Installation

1. Install the plugin package in your Backstage app:

   ```bash
   yarn --cwd packages/app add @kienlt/backstage-plugin-random-quote
   ```

2. Import the card component into your `EntityPage.tsx`:

   ```tsx
   import { RandomQuoteCard } from '@kienlt/backstage-plugin-random-quote';
   ```

3. Add the card to your desired layout:

   ```tsx
   <Grid item xs={12}>
     <RandomQuoteCard />
   </Grid>
   ```
